name: Issued Licenses
attribution: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP)
description: This dataset features licenses issued by the NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP)—formerly the Department of Consumer Affairs (DCA).

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: An identification number issued to a business or individual when their license application is approved by DCWP.

columns.name: Business Name
columns.description: The legal business name as filed with the New York State Secretary of State or County Clerk or, if an individual, the person’s first name and last name.

columns.name: DBA/Trade Name
columns.description: The "Doing Business As" or "Trade Name" registered with the NYS Department of State.

columns.name: Business Unique ID
columns.description: An identification number assigned by DCWP to track unique businesses across its systems.

columns.name: Business Category
columns.description: The business activity or business category requiring a DCWP-issued license in order to operate legally within NYC.

columns.name: License Type
columns.description: Indicates whether the license is issued to an individual or an organization.

columns.name: License Status
columns.description: Indicates the current status of the license.

columns.name: Initial Issuance Date
columns.description: The date the license was originally issued.

columns.name: Expiration Date
columns.description: The date the license term expired or will expire.

columns.name: Details
columns.description: Additional information about the license for certain business categories.
